name: SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov
description: Search SAMHSA's directory for mental health and substance use treatment facilities. Contact a provider directly to confirm services, eligibility, and current availability.

name: HRSA Find a Health Center
description: Locate HRSA-supported health centers. Contact a center to ask which behavioral or physical health services it offers and what payment options are available.

name: SAMHSA National Helpline
description: SAMHSA's free, confidential treatment referral and information service for people facing mental and/or substance use disorders.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: The 988 Lifeline provides free, confidential support for people in suicidal crisis or emotional distress. If there is immediate danger, contact emergency services.
